purpose: Phase 2 interim asset-preparation proof for a possible 2D face-photo overlay

steps: Resize each selected source to 1600 px wide
Apply a hand-authored front-frame silhouette mask
Clear the two lens interiors so a customer photo can show through
Exclude visible stock labels, printed lens text and rear temples where the mask allows
Trim to the transparent object bounds and add 20 px transparent padding

The visible label was removed by excluding the lens interior, not by reconstructing the frame texture
